description: Phase 09 Prompt 32 — agent performance and feedback. A read-only, advisory per-agent tracker over the Phase 08A agent registry that aggregates repeated corrections (operator feedback of class correct/reject), review burden (agent_run_receipts review tiers), and weak coverage (corpus-balance empty/deferred families), and emits advisory policy recommendation codes — for operator awareness. It makes NO determination; recommendations are advisory suggestions, never applied. Persists metadata-only per-(agent, metric) rows to the reserved V38 second_brain_agent_performance_feedback_runs table (read-only by default). No raw feedback reason / prompt / response is persisted or emitted — only counts, bucketed bands, agent names, metric names, and recommendation codes.
